description: This file defines a model class 'WorkWeekIndexedModel' used in the Leave API module of the OrangeHRM system. It implements serialization features for representing a work week with indexed properties, based on an underlying 'WorkWeek' entity.

classes.name: WorkWeekIndexedModel
classes.description: A serializable model representing a work week with indexed day properties, used in the Leave API of OrangeHRM.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the model with a WorkWeek entity, sets filters for days of the week, and maps attribute names to indices.
